target.title: fix: load plan utilization history off the startup main thread
target.body:
## Problem

`UsageStore.init` previously called `PlanUtilizationHistoryStore.load()` synchronously on the main actor. A mature two-year, two-provider history blocks the startup main thread for ~150 ms (Release benchmark from the original audit).

## Fix

Move the decode onto a utility-priority detached task and publish the result through the existing `planUtilizationHistoryRevision` path:

- `PlanUtilizationHistoryStore` and its cross-task types are now `Sendable`; the store gains a `loadAsync()` helper.
- `UsageStore.init` starts a one-shot background load task. In-memory history starts empty.
- A new `planUtilizationHistoryLoaded` flag gates sync menu accessors and mutation paths so a startup refresh cannot overwrite real disk history with an empty in-memory stub.
- `recordPlanUtilizationHistorySample` awaits the load before mutating.

The load publishes exactly once via a generation-guarded write.

## Tests

- New `UsageStorePlanUtilizationAsyncLoadTests` covers the gate-released publish path, sync menu gating, empty/corrupt file best-effort, multi-provider/multi-account ownership preservation, and init independence from history size.
- Existing `UsageStorePlanUtilizationTests.makeStore` and `UsageStorePlanUtilizationClaudeIdentityTests.makeReloadedStoreWithConfiguredTokenAccount` updated to cancel/await the load via new test seams (`_cancelPlanUtilizationHistoryLoadForTesting`, `_waitForPlanUtilizationHistoryLoadForTesting`) to preserve their pre-async-load intent.
- One `StatusMenuHighlightTests` flake (`hosted submenu close resumes deferred explicit rebuild on fresh parent`) was caused by the load's revision bump landing inside the test's yield loop; the test now cancels the load deterministically.

## Verification

- `swift test --filter PlanUtilization`: 144/144 pass
- `swift test --filter StatusMenu`: 349/349 pass
- `swift test --filter StatusMenuHostedSubmenuRefreshTests`: 11/11 pass
- `swift test --filter UsageStoreDisabledProviderCleanupTests`: 4/4 pass (from #3)
- `swift test --filter AgentSessionMenuDescriptorTests`: 8/8 pass (from #1)
- `make check`: 0 violations

`KiroStatusProbeTests.accepted pipe output cannot overrun the usage deadline` is a pre-existing flake unrelated to this PR — it fails under `make test` parallel-group scheduling but passes in isolation, and its assertions about PTY marker file cleanup touch no code paths this PR modifies.

## Out of scope

JSON schema, two-year retention policy, account ownership and ordering semantics are unchanged. This does not change the persistence format, sampling frequency, chart rendering, or Cost History. It only moves the existing on-disk decode off the startup critical path.

target.title: Contain Codex interleaved overcount and add fork provenance fixtures (#2037)
target.body:
## Summary
- Contain intra-file interleaved Codex cumulative counters with the file-local watermark/min-cap policy from #2066.
- Add sanitized Issue #2037 fork-family fixtures and hand oracles (`33ce→3869`, `4d90→52bf`, and missing-parent siblings).
- Lock ordinary parent-present `#1164` accounting with scanner integration tests.
- Document the P0 corpus findings and canonical fork-family provenance design.
- **Does not close #2037.** The affected Ultra reporter shape and a complete cross-file provenance ledger remain open.

## Missing-parent safety decision
- Runtime token-only sibling-prefix suppression was removed in `5441ff75`.
- Distinct sibling events can have identical `last_token_usage` / `total_token_usage` vectors at the same ordinal. Treating those counters as event identity can silently undercount legitimate work.
- Envelope timestamps are rewritten across copied prefixes, model is not reliably present on `token_count`, and adding more token fields only reduces collision probability. Therefore missing-parent siblings fail open: retain possible copied-prefix overcount rather than destructively suppress ambiguous rows.
- A focused equal-counter sibling regression asserts both distinct events remain billable.

## Deferred provenance work
- Prove a copy-stable event identity stronger than token values.
- Build cross-window family closure, collision handling, ownership migration, and the incomplete/contained quality path.
- Add redacted initial and cached repeat-scan output from an affected real Codex setup. Sanitized fixtures and tests are supplemental evidence, not that live proof.

## Relationship to #2066
- This branch contains the #2066 file-local containment commit; the two PRs should not be merged independently as separate implementations.
- The provenance fixtures/specs in this PR are design evidence for the later family-ledger work, not a claim that token-only cross-file dedupe is safe.
- Neither PR uses `Fixes #2037`.

## Test plan
- [x] `swift test --filter Issue2037`
- [x] `swift test --filter 'codex interleaved'`
- [x] `swift test --filter 'codex forked child'`
- [x] `make check`
- [x] `make test` — 618 selections, 52/52 groups passed
- [ ] Redacted initial + cached repeat-scan output from an affected real setup

target.title: Avoid duplicate Agent Sessions remote refresh passes
target.body:
## Summary
- Coalesce unchanged overlapping Agent Sessions remote refresh requests into the active pass instead of scheduling a duplicate Tailscale discovery and SSH sweep.
- Preserve generation invalidation, stale-result suppression, and one immediate retry when Agent Sessions settings change during a pass.
- Add focused gate coverage and document the user-visible efficiency fix with contributor credit.

## Validation
- Exact head: `61cdbdc21983fa0902406df14a2f28c1defa636c`, synchronized with current `main`.
- Focused Agent Sessions/Tailscale and synchronized-main suites: 115/115 passed.
- Settings-change gate proof: stale generation is not published and exactly one current-generation retry follows.
- `make check`: generated docs, locale checks, SwiftFormat, and SwiftLint clean.
- Zero-retry full suite: 624/624 selections across 52/52 groups, all first-pass; no retries or timeouts.
- Autoreview: clean, no accepted/actionable findings; 0.96 correctness confidence.
- Exact Developer ID-signed debug bundle: embedded commit `61cdbdc2`; strict code-sign and Gatekeeper accepted.
- Packaged live app with isolated config, Keychain disabled, and local no-network Tailscale/SSH wrappers: five menu opens completed in 2.028 seconds during one blocked pass; counts stayed at discovery/fetch `1/0`, then settled at `1/1`; the menu rendered `qa-host — 1` / `qa-shared`.
- Production CodexBar PID, executable path, start time, and restored debug defaults remained unchanged.

## Risk
Low. Concurrent callers now share an active remote failure instead of forcing an immediate duplicate pass; the next menu open or normal 60-second cycle retries. Settings changes still force one current-generation pass.

## Dependencies
No dependency changes; freshness review not applicable.
